review_scope: Independent pre-implementation review; no reliance on other reviews, production edits, comparative workload or model closure execution.

evidence_checked.manifest: Canonical files-array root recomputed; all 56 file hashes match.
evidence_checked.model: Inspected all 22 Lean theorem statements and transition/selection definitions, exact type/axiom inventory, claims, two witnesses and registered verifier. Executed source_inventory static checks successfully for 22 types/claims; no clean build claim made.
evidence_checked.verifier: Exact-root six-seat gate, snapshot hashes, inherited309/supplement checks without reproof, two fresh-directory builds, exact elaborated-type/axiom outputs, matching artifacts and final mutation checks are explicit.
evidence_checked.baseline: Read actual BubblewrapLauncher constructor/launch/argv, DocumentWorker frame and recovery handling, DocumentQueries advisory construction, default mutation factory/revalidation callsites, DocumentWorkerMain and FrameProcess lifecycle, and original HTTP benchmark sampling.

assessment: One fixed JVM argument has a precise insertion boundary. Package-private immutable profile selection admits no browser/request/environment flag list; solver selection rejects the advisory profile. Existing constructors remain DEFAULT.

DocumentMutations retains DocumentWorker::new, including commit VALIDATE and history REVALIDATE. Nondefault revalidate is explicitly rejected before launch; the separately named gate probe cannot relax that production guard.

Actual constructor BuildIdentity and per-launch Alloy/full-build checks remain measured, with existing sandbox mounts, environment clearing, limits, framing and reap fences. Runtime exact full-argv extraction and complete callsite checks are required before activation.

Full private-response comparison covers all fields, preserving existing identities/source/diagnostics and allowing only injective kind-preserving generated-ID normalization on declared slots. Negative cases cover changed reference edges, alias collisions, unexpected fields and unsafe UUID replacement; concrete comparator and fixtures remain prerequisites.

F1 selection requires all three independent paired whole-stack HTTP runs to have zero errors, strict nearest-rank p95 below300ms and below paired F0, with peak memory at most5GiB. Six-GiB containment ceiling is distinct from the five-GiB objective. No averaging rescues failure.

Effective four-CPU quota, no-swap six-GiB group cap and descendant ownership must be observed before workload; fallback without containment is forbidden. Affinity is correctly distinguished from security containment.
limitations: Approval concerns the implementation/experiment contract only. The 22-claim model has not been clean-built by this reviewer and no runtime/performance result is certified.

RequiredArgs and measured Run fields are abstract trusted inputs. Syntactic flag insertion and guarded lifecycle theorems do not prove JVM/JIT semantics, Java correspondence, sandbox isolation, output equivalence or actual timing.

Concrete fixture bytes, full-response comparator, negative comparator cases, complete runtime claim set, source/build/argv inventories and executable verifiers must be frozen before comparative work. The category list is not completed test evidence.

Existing benchmark retains only a subset of warmup timing observations; the future harness must meet the stronger frozen requirement to retain every warmup/measured request and error, rather than treating the old script alone as sufficient.

Finite heavy document probe results must record regressions and block new timeouts/output differences. Keeping WorkerMain default avoids claiming solver gains from advisory results; lower optimization may still have workload-dependent CPU costs.
P1 context cleanup and full-history behavior must be identical in both variants and satisfy their independent runtime obligations; this contract cannot discharge outstanding P1 availability limits.
Four-CPU/six-GiB workstation screening cannot establish performance on the intended four-vCPU/eight-GiB host. Target acceptance remains OPEN pending three starts on that pinned actual server/VM.
Three paired passing runs establish the registered finite selection result, not universal latency, throughput or semantic equivalence. All failed/invalid run evidence must remain preserved.
commercial_scope: NO_GO remains: this optimization does not close Alloy/dependency redistribution, browser/customer/security or actual target-host acceptance. No commercial readiness or measured performance claim is authorized by this review.
